title: Play with Containers
tagline: Microservices behind an API gateway, packaged with optimized Dockerfiles and wired together with Docker Compose.
summary: A microservices system containerized from scratch: an API gateway, application services, PostgreSQL databases and a RabbitMQ queue, all started with Docker Compose. I wrote the Dockerfiles, set up the networks and volumes, and documented how to run everything.
problem: Package several services so that anyone can start the whole system with one command, with data that survives restarts and services that reach each other over Docker networks.
role: Solo project: Dockerfiles, Compose file, networks, volumes and documentation. [TODO: confirm the services match the diagram (inventory and billing apps)]
